businessOverview: Feed Flow is an iPhone baby tracker for feeding, WHO growth references and baby health records. It supports breastfeeding, formula, pumping, solids, allergens, reactions, medicines, vaccines and vitamin D. Differentiators include lock-screen bottle countdowns, FlowCast next-feed predictions and optional notifications, automatic vitamin D arithmetic from drops and formula labels, and feeding-and-growth PDF reports. Built in Norway by Zeolite. Everyday logging is free, with optional premium planning and reporting.
audiences: Breastfeeding, formula-feeding, mixed-feeding and pumping parents
Parents introducing solid foods and allergens
Parents tracking WHO weight, height and head-circumference growth
Parents recording medicines, vaccines, reactions and vitamin D
Parents looking for next-feed predictions or a feeding-and-growth report
IBCLCs, lactation consultants and feeding professionals
Eligible parent creators and family-community ambassadors
currentGoal: Increase qualified non-branded organic and AI-assisted discovery of the app and its ambassador program with unique, useful pages rather than keyword stuffing. Measure search impressions, clicks, AI citations and App Store outbound clicks after Search Console and OpenSEO are connected.
positioning: Calm, comprehensive and non-judgemental. Record-keeping only: no diagnosis, personalized dosing instructions, brand ranking or fabricated clinical endorsement. Real app screenshots and real reviews lead; baby data stays in the parent's own iCloud. No invented search-volume or market-leadership claims.
